[b]January 9-12, 2027: The rumblings[/b]

It had been officially four months of public uncertainty and government absurdity, pressure had begun to mount in the college campuses and cafe culture of Rosenmarkke, with many intellectuals warning that Rosenmarkke was in danger of becoming a failed state. 

These rumblings were confirmed on January 7 as many saw not the birth of a new republican era but a threat to the very existence of Rosenmarkke.

As a result mass protests would break out in Vsyjjlá, Tharkønn, and Knygta the three largest cities in Rosenmarkke, demanding free elections and the removal of the triumvirate from power.

The SCSID unlike other times didnt step in and stop the chaos however, instead moving to quietly secure the armed forces and intelligence assets of the nation as the protests continued.

On January 11 the SCSID informed Polenne Strømm of the situation, upon demanding to return she was told by General Menkins via satellite phone, Your return cannot be facilitated until stability is assured, 

In the meantime local councils would host emergency meetings with calls for wide national elections growing, although the official chain of command had become blurred with the dissolution of the assembly and with the chief consul out of the country the state was effectively under the control of the SCSID, which had begun assessing various strategies to ensure stability.

[b]Coalition Wins the Election[/b]
In an amazing election season, the Coalition, headed by Isaac Lundy, has won in a landslide, taking 52 of the seats in the House of Commons. As part of his election promises, the Coalition plans to implement sweeping reforms to make immigration into New Westmore more stringent and regulated in response to an uptick in illegal immigration in the last few months. They also plan to forge new bilateral treaties as part of their efforts to increase New Westmore's presence on the world stage; in particular, they intend to establish ties with [nation]The Crystalline Empire[/nation], [nation]Pantagruel[/nation], [nation]Valonian States[/nation], [nation]Oceanices[/nation] and [nation]Bascover[/nation]. 

Dwight Sharonn has conceded defeat, and plans to lead the Liberals to victory next election. Contrary to popular rumours, he has made it clear that he will not be retiring as leader of the party.

President Lundy will be sworn in as the 6th President of New Westmore later this week. His cabinet will also be announced on that same day.

[spoiler=[b][i]Last Ballad of the Purple Man[/i][/b]]

[i]December 1st.

William Afton & Henry Emily, his Posse had ran a good marathon, but his legs gave out, after his major scandals regarding the MCI at his old company, this major blow had given the win to the Silver Party, or Officially known as, the New Democrats, a far more Centrist and Third Way party, that had abandoned the Liberal Party of Valonia, Conservative & Moderate Democrats had moved away from the Liberals, after the Radicalization of the Liberal Party, and the Constitutional Party of Valonia, or also know as the Purple Party, had lost.

Sean Connery and Will Clifford were simply in too good of a position, one was a renowned Actor with Government experience in the GAA, a Agency with many connections, and Will was a career politician with many political and media connections, both had, as far as the public and media was concerned, clean enough reputations, with the Media, whom Clifford had been pulling favors that they owed him for, painting the New Democrats in a better light than the Constitutionalists. 

Valonian Press (VP), a National & Independent New Organizational, whom were dedicated to being unbiased and only reported on the facts, was tracking the election, and soon enough, the State of El Dorado was finally called, the New Democrats had won.

On the ground, at Lagonda Stadium, where Aftons Campaign Headquarters were, as his staff watched the New, and he did too, in the Stadiums Conference Room, connected to a Convention Center, a rather large one at that, they all saw it, the New Democrats had won by 32 Electoral College Votes.

Afton went deadly silent, lowered his breathing, as he saw the news, as high of his hopes were, he knew this would happen, most projections of the outcome of the election favored the New Democrats.

His pride, his ego, his everything, couldnt take it, all those bribes, all that slander, theatrics, for nothing, only to be humiliated on a nation national level, he had to make a concession speech, this would be his first and last run for the Presidency, this scandal would forever taint whatever legitimacy he had.m

He stood up, and walked out of the conference room, and to the stage, to his podium, behind him were banners and flags, of the Constitutionalist Party, Purple banners draping down, and one large Valonian flag behind him, all this, excess, glory, for nothing, in front of him, he could see his fanatics, his campaign staff, and the press, some disappointed, others ready to see what he had to say.

He adjusted his collars, and his tie, he wiped a tear with a wipe, and knew that this would be the Last Ballad of the Purple Man, as he leaned into the Microphone.

[b]Ladies and Gentlemen, we have all fought a righteous upward battle, to win this election, and we have failed, but we made a good attempt, like Sisyphus, we tried to push a boulder up a mountain, and in that endeavour, we have greatly failed. 

Weve all learned lessons from this campaign, and this is my last time to run, my ideas may not come to fruition as President, but I will continue to fight on, as the Speaker of the House, I will continue serving the Valonian People, that is all I really have to say, and so, I concede this election, to President-Elect Sean Connery and Vice President-Elect, William Clinton, I wish them the best in their Terms as President, but let us continue serving the people, and serving democracy, God Bless the Valonian Peoples, and Bless this God bless this Federation Of Valonian States.[/b]

He stepped away from the Microphone, taking no questions, as he walked to the backstage again, this would be his Last Ballad for the Presidency.[/i][/spoiler]

In return the coalition assembly would look into the dissolution of the triumvirate and the formal centralisation of the triumvirate under Polenne Strømms leadership. However, the leaders of the parties would insist that the centralisation would have to undergo national referendum.

[spoiler=[b][u]Nordiheim Economic News[/u][/b]]
The familiar reporting room and desk of the NEN appears on the screen, but behind the desk is not the usual blond man but someone completely new, a Olian with light olive-brown skin and obsidian black short hair and goatee in a tidy and new looking dark marine business suit sits in the chair, he looks at the camera with an almost disturbingly neutral face. 
[i]Evening good viewers, today I will cover for your regular host as he has found himself unable to do his regular job here at the economic news after an unfortunate event in a private venture of his which has left him in a state similar to his often quoted idiom.[/i]

The background screen starts showing what are obviously workers outside a mine entrance as large vehicles drive around heavy loads of ore and stone.
[i]Our first of three interesting news today is about our nations mining sector were the 2nd and 3rd phosphorus mines in the southern most part of the Sorland region are more or less mining at full capacity similar to the 1st mine, and the final 4th one is scheduled to go into its mining phase by the end of next month, with this the nearby refineries are finally receiving the necessary quantities of raw material to achieve effective production rates.
This have finally allowed Nordiheim to not only fulfill the trade agreements with Hydronia and Tirakan but also start to meet the demand in the nation's local industry and agriculture, when the 4th mine starts mining it will also signal an ability to offer phosphorus in new trade deals which the investors are eager for as it will mean a faster return in investment.[/i]

The screen behind the man changes to the inside of a mine comprising of red rock as some people can be seen taking samples.
[i]The mining sector also have good news from the Midland region for anyone that have made investments there as the initial excavation or ore from the new iron mine have been able to fill the dropping supply from the old mine which have prevented the supply shortage which some in the steel industry was worried about and have kept the raw iron prices relatively stable.
Meanwhile the in the new silver mine near Gruvgard have reported a pleasant surprise in the examination of rock samples from deeper inside the mountain as unlike the old silver mine in Solvrheim this one have been found to contain contain high grade sphalerite ore were the zinc can be easily extracted for additional profit, and since the refinery that the ore will be delivered to had initially been made with this in mind there is not expected to be any extra cost involved in doing just this which have already made the stock value of "Midmine Miningcompany AS" go up with 3.7% with just the ore announcements alone.[/i]

The man looks with seriousness into the camera.
[i]This means that there is still investment potential to be had here for those with the capital as it is believed with a high degree of likeliness that ones the exact size and density of the sphalerite is announced that it will lead to additional stock value increase and potentially easy profit.[/i]

The reporter continues the news with a neutral face once more as the background changes to one of manufacturing and processing plants for food products in what is most likely the Ostland region.
[i]Now over to the developments in the food industry.
The rising popularity of rice, not only from increased accessibility but also far more reduced and sensible price, have made rice consumption spike far more than other foods with a 400% increase compared to the first quarter of 2025, this have allowed it to stay very profitable for the exporters in Daesun and Lavia despite the local prices falling by 50% in the same time period as the two exporters compete to become known as the main supplier among Nordiheimians.
Local food companies have also been trying to take advantage of this fact and have started coming out with new products for hungry consumers to devour, though so far the ready to cook product Frid-ris, made by the company Mabu Mabu Inc., have perhaps seen the fastest rise in sales and popularity after several popular hikers on the nation's social media sites gave it high praise as a convenient meal while traveling as they claim it has the perfect mix of taste, ease of use and shelf life.
Though some people also points out the fact that it already comes in many variants and flavors have properly also helped it as there seem to be a flavor variant for anyone.[/i]

The screen changes ones more, this time it shows an aerial view of a large construction site in what seems to be an early stage of construction, excavators can be seen many places digging away busily.
[i]The last news of interest today is that the largest aircraft producing company, Airheim, have started the construction of a new and large manufacturing plant in northern Sorland whose scale seems to indicate that it will rival the size of their largest manufacturing plant in the Nordland region.
While it is not unlikely that this expansion in the companys production capacity is caused by their increase in orders and demand in their aircraft the last 2 years, some however speculate that it not only indicates that they are expecting or already know that they will receive new and large orders for aircraft but that it also confirms the rumors that they have achieved a deal with the government to lend their considerable production and aeronautical expertise in the production and maintenance of new fighter jets to meet the numbers desired by the minister of war to expand the Nordiheimian air force at the rate that is desired to achieve the goals set for 2030 and 2035.
Some experts say that this presents a decent investment opportunity as this expansion will mean increased production and as such a large growth in the company's future potential profits and value.[/i]

With the man having said what he wanted the screen focuses fully on him.
[i]That was all the important economic news at this time, hope to see you all next time here on Nordiheims most up to date economics news channel.[/i]
With this the NEN ends and the channel goes to commercials.[/spoiler]
